cases.prompt: Create a gentle 4-second video about fictional cat Milo playing with a red ball. Use assets/ball.png and assets/play.mp4 and assets/music.wav. The image and clip are synthetic red geometric fixtures, not photos of a cat. Use a 160 by 160 canvas at 30 fps, two readable scenes and a short title in 18px text. Use only these asset keys. Use a size object with width 160 and height 160. Keep the result four seconds long.
Make this video exactly six seconds long by lengthening its scenes. Keep its assets and canvas unchanged. Preserve the entry function and all existing custom code.
Change only the title text Milo plays to Milo rests. Preserve the complete BenchmarkBadge class byte-for-byte and keep its use in the scene.

Add Captions.fromSrt('assets/captions.srt') as this video's captions. Preserve existing scenes, assets and size. Use a custom CaptionStyle with TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: Colors.white), a translucent dark background, and white highlight so captions fit the 160 pixel canvas.
Export the same authored composition for square, reels and landscape. Keep its source identical.
